layers.label: Flood risk with NISAR-observed water (candidate)
layers.note: Flood index (TPI) raised to Critical where the latest NISAR radar pass up to 12 days before the map day saw open water (HH < −18 dB, outside permanent water): max(TPI, 0.8 × water).
